headline: Big defensive stop for the Chiefs
what_happened: The Colts tried to pass the ball on third down, but the pass fell incomplete and they failed to gain yards.
who: D.Jones threw the ball while F.Anudike-Uzomah pressured him for the Chiefs.
why_it_matters: This is great news for the Chiefs because it forces the Colts into a tough spot and lowers their chances of winning by 8 percentage points.
